actors.name: Marlin Bay Unified school board (as a body)
actors.private_context: The board has the proposal on its agenda for both September meetings. Two trustees are up for re-election in November. The board operates under standard procedures: a recorded vote occurs when a trustee requests it or when the board chair decides to record it. The board is aware of the parent group's plan to pack public comment.

actors.name: Parent group
actors.private_context: The group has promised to pack the public-comment period at the September meetings to advocate for the later-start-times proposal. They have no formal decision-making power on the board.

starting_events.description: The school board's first September meeting is scheduled to occur on a date in early September (e.g., September 8) and the second on a date later in September (e.g., September 22). The proposal is on the agenda for both meetings.
